Cloud security is an engineering gate, not a compliance report

Cloud incidents are mostly self-inflicted: a public bucket, an over-privileged role, an untagged resource nobody owns. Cloud security posture is the discipline of making the misconfiguration impossible or short-lived — guardrails in the IaC pipeline, continuous posture checks with dwell-time metrics, and entitlement right-sizing that actually shrinks blast radius.

Multi-cloud makes it worse: three consoles, three policy dialects, three sets of blind spots. We normalize posture into one control model with per-cloud adapters, so dwell time is measured the same way everywhere.
Below: the failure modes that turn cloud posture into churn, the reference architecture of the guardrail system, and the console that trends dwell time and entitlements.
Four failure modes that turn posture into churn
Each of these regenerates the same misconfigurations weekly — the countermeasures move the fix upstream into the pipeline, where it stays fixed.

widgets.title: Posture pipeline — click stages for the enforcement contract

stages.name: Pre-deploy
stages.detail: Policy checks in the deploy pipeline reject misconfigurations before they exist — public stores, wildcard IAM and unencrypted paths fail the PR, with the fix linked.

stages.name: Detect
stages.detail: Continuous scanning for what shipped anyway: drift against declared config, exposure scoring with attack-path context — findings deduped by class.

stages.name: Triage
stages.detail: Findings route by class with fix SLAs (critical 24h, high 7d) and owners from the catalog — severity argued once per class, not per ticket.

stages.name: Fix
stages.detail: Fixes land as guardrail changes where possible (the class never recurs) or as IaC changes verified by re-scan before closure.

stages.name: Evidence
stages.detail: Weekly posture report: attack-surface trend, fix SLA compliance, static-key burn-down — the CISO's numbers and the teams' numbers are the same numbers.

widgets.note: The pipeline's point: misconfigurations are prevented where possible, fixed by class where not, and every closure carries re-scan evidence.
